content: José sogsad ede doawa

José bela-dulemar-ega-arbamalad-asabin geg na san bargagussoggu, binnasur goted: “¡Bela bemar-wegi-bukmalad ainimar!” A-ulale, Joséʼga-arbamalad ainidmalad, wargwensaale bukwa gussulid. Agine, José e-gwenadganga sogsad, ede doawa.
Geb degine, José binnasur boded. Degisoggu, bela Egipto-dulemar itosmalad, degi, Faraón-negginmaladse-bakar neg-gunaid wisgusmalad.
José, e-gwenadganga sogded: —Ani, an José. ¿An-bab amba dula? E-gwenadgan José-asabin-bukwadi, bela-bela dobe-itomarsoggu, geg abinsagusmalad.
Ar Joséʼdi e-gwenadganga sogded: —Wis be anse walikaa dagmala. José-e-gwenadgan José-walik-gunonimargu, José ega sogded: —Ani an be-urba-José gued. Epenne bemar Egipto-dulega an-uksa gusmaladid.
”Degi-inigwele, ar be an-uksamaladba, mer bemar surbinsa-itomalo, mer sae be dukin itomarbalo. Ar ade, Bab-Dummad bemar-idu dulemar-baigan-bendakega an-barmialid, adi, melle ukudba burgwemalagar.
Emide, we-yargi ukud-naid-akar birgabogusad. Amba birgatar napid. Ar dulemar ibmar-digmaloen-inigwele, ibmar-weosurmalad.

Degi-inigwele, we-napneggi bemar mer berguega, Bab-Dummad bemar-idu an-barmialid, adi, bemar mer ukudba burgwegar. Degine, Bab-Dummad ibmar-gegerdaklegedgi bemar-bendakega, degi, be-mimmigan-nue-bendakega, an-imaksad.

”Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad wese an-barmialid, bemar an-barmiarsulid. Bab-Dummad Faraónʼga binsaed-dakedgaguega an-onugsasad. Bela Faraón-negdakega, degine, bela Egipto-yargi negdaked-dummadga-megega an-onugsasbalid.
Gwae an-babse gannar be namar. Ega be sognamar: ‘Be-machi-José sogye: Bab-Dummad bela Egipto-yar-dakega an-onugsasye. Gwae be an-dakdagoye, mer be yogguoye.
Gosén-yalaganba be-mimmigan-abargi, be-wagan-abargi, bela be-ibmar-durgan-abargi, degi, bela be-ibmar-nikad-abargi be megoye. Deyobi, be an-walikaa megoye.
Ar ade, amba birgatar ukud-dummad naguosoggu, ani, an bega, be-neguyaginmaladga, degi, bela beba-gudidimaladga an mas ukoye, adi, melle ibmar-sate bemar gumalagarye.’
”An-urba-Benjamín, degi, bemar-sunnagwad an bemarga bela-ibmar-sognaid be nue an-itosmalad.
Bela an-babga be sogmalo, ani an Egipto-yargi bela-bela gangued-nika maiye. Degine, bela wegi be ibmar-daksamalad an-babga be sogmarbalo. ¡Gwae be namar! ¡Gwae an-bab be sedamalo!”
José e-urba-Benjamín angaagwar-imakdegu, boded. Benjamín e-ia-Joséʼgi-akas-nai bonai gusmogad.
Geb degine, José bela e-iamar-angaagwar-gadgu, ise-boar e-iamar-wagar-unai gusad. Bela bonanai gusmalad. Weyob-gusad-sorba, geb e-iamar Joséʼga nabir sunmakded.
Faraón-e-negyagi bela José-e-gwenadgan-nonimarye wisgusmalad. Faraón weligwar itosad, degine, dummagan-ega-arbamalad weligwar itosmarmogad.
Geb degine, Faraón Joséʼga sogded: “Be-gwenadganga be sogo: ‘Be-moli-uayasuid-birgi ibmar-nasikye, Canaán-yarse gannar be namarye.’ ”
Faraón Joséʼga sogdebalid: “Be-iamarga be sogo: ‘Anga be-bab, degi, be-gwenadgan-Canaánʼgi-bukwad be sedagoye. Egipto-yargi napa-bur-nued an ega ukoye, degine, we-yargi mas-nued gunmaloye.’

”Deginbali, José, be-gwenadganga be igar-ukbalo: ‘We-Egiptoʼgi urmar-napagined-ibmar-seed sedmarye, adi, be-omegan, be-mimmigan, degi, bemar-bab sedagegarye. Be-gwenadgan-Canaánʼgi-bukwadga be sogmaloye: Be dagmarye.
Deginbali, melle ibmar-nikmaladgi binsamaloye, ar ade, Egipto-yargi bur-ibmar-nued-nikadi bemargadga guoeddeeye.’ ”
Israel-e-masmala deyob imaksamalad. José, Faraón-ega-sogsadba, e-gwenadganga urmar-napagined-ibmar-seed uksad, degine, igarba mas-gunnega ega mas uksabalid.
Deginbali, José, mor-binigan e-iamarga uksabalid. Benjamínʼgardi mani-dulataled-ilapaa-aidikue-wilub (300) ega uksad, degine, mor, goatar ega uksabalid.

E-babgardi ibmar-nuegan-Egiptoʼgi-nikad moli-uayasuid-warambe (10) ena-ena barmisad. Degine, e-bab igarba mas-gunnega, moli-uayasuid-omegan-warambe (10), orosgi-dakleged, madumar, degi, masgullemalad, ena-ena barmisbalid.
José nuedgi e-gwenadgan-barmisgu, amarga sogsad: “Melle igarba be urwenadapi gumalo.” Geb degine, e-iamar nadsunnad.
José-e-gwenadgan Egipto-yargi nadsunnad. Canaán-yarse e-bab-maidse modapmalad.
Jacobʼga sogdapmargu: “José amba dula-gudiiye, Egipto-yargi dummadga negdakmaiye.” Jacob, e-masmala ega ibmar-sognaid geg itoged, geg ibmar-soge naded. Ar ade, e-masmala-bened.
Ar e-masmala José-ibmar-sogsad bela Jacobʼga sogsamalad. Jacob dakdebalid, Egiptoʼse e-sedega urmar-napagined-ibmar-seed José ega barmiali, Jacob bela-bela yeer itonaded.
Geb degine, Jacob sogded: “¡Emigindi, an nue bensurdo, an-machi-José amba dula-gudiid! Burgwed-idu an daknaoed.”
